title: Elliott Takes Stake in Deutsche Telekom, Opposes T-Mobile Deal
summary: Activist investor Elliott Investment Management has built a stake in Deutsche Telekom and is pushing the German company to abandon any effort to merge with T-Mobile US, according to people familiar with the matter.  Deutsche Telekom owns 54% of T-Mobile and has held discussions this year about combining the two companies to create a more streamlined telecom behemoth.  On Thursday, Deutsche Telekom’s stock traded higher in Germany, while T-Mobile’s New York-listed shares rose in premarket trading.
